device.description: Dual 16-bit voltage-output DAC (external reference) with 24-bit SPI-compatible write-only interface, software load commands and per-channel power-down
device.note: dac8552.pdf (SLAS430A) p.3 power requirements (VDD 2.7-5.5 V), p.4 pin configuration and descriptions, p.5 serial write operation and timing characteristics (SYNC falls with SCLK high, data on SCLK falling edges), p.13-14 serial interface and input shift register (Figure 43), p.14 control matrix (Table 1) and power-down commands (Table 2), p.15 SYNC interrupt, power-on reset (zero scale), power-down modes (Table 3)

registers.name: DAC_A
registers.note: DAC register A; power-on zero scale (p.15)

registers.name: DAC_B
registers.note: DAC register B; power-on zero scale (p.15)

registers.name: PWR
registers.note: internal: PD1:PD0 (DB17:DB16) last written to each buffer (Tables 2-3): 00 normal, 01 1 kohm, 10 100 kohm, 11 Hi-Z

protocol.note: 24-bit word: DB23-DB22 reserved 0, DB21 LD B, DB20 LD A, DB19 don't care, DB18 buffer select (0 = A, 1 = B), DB17-DB16 PD1 PD0, DB15-DB0 data. Executed on the 24th SCLK falling edge; SYNC high earlier discards the word

pages: p.3 (VDD 2.7-5.5 V), p.4 (pins), p.5 (timing), p.13-14 (serial interface, input shift register Figure 43, Tables 1-2), p.15 (SYNC interrupt, power-on reset, power-down Table 3)
notModeled: analog outputs and output amplifiers (VOUTA/VOUTB never driven); power-down output loads stored in PWR only

the power-down condition takes effect when the channel receives a load command; the model stores PD1:PD0 per buffer at once. A power-down word with a load of its own channel does not change the DAC data register; loads of the other channel (and the load-both word) copy the buffers
no read-back: the interface is write-only
SCLK limits (30 / 20 MHz) and setup/hold times t1-t9
variants: dac8552.pdf covers only the DAC8552. DAC8532 is the earlier pin-compatible dual; DAC8554/DAC8555 are the quad versions.
